title: NCAA: Cuenco’s career-high powers Mapua over EAC in overtime
summary: Marc Cuenco found his touch from long range as Mapua University outlasted Emilio Aguinaldo College in overtime, 89-84, in NCAA Season 102 on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
